description: BASE ONLY, EXECUTED (not a quote). Can you get out of a Base token, and what does it cost? Executes a buy and a full sell through its deepest pool we can simulate (Uniswap v2/v3/v4 against WETH or ETH, Virtuals agent tokens through their VIRTUAL pool, Aerodrome basic and Slipstream pools) in one simulated Base block and returns the ETH that comes back, the round-trip cost and the revert reason if a leg fails. $0.01 per call over x402 (Base USDC first).
